summary.text: Beau Ballard is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 21, serving since January 4, 2023, when he was appointed to replace Mike Hilgers, who resigned; he was elected in 2024. His committee assignments are Health and Human Services, Nebraska Retirement Systems, and Transportation and Telecommunications.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Ballard was born May 5, 1994, in Lincoln and graduated from Parkview Christian High School.
He attended Colorado Christian University and the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
His biography lists his occupation as business owner, a past role as a legislative staff member, and membership in Calvary Community Church.
